initialization: Fresh start at t=0 for every dt; unchanged deterministic native perturbation. No warm start from an evolved coarse trajectory.

acceptance.solver: Correct endpoint, finite arrays, no HDF5/solver errors; one readable equilibrium export
acceptance.temporal: Finest adjacent pair <=1% volume-time RMS field error relative to temporal variation in every field and <=1% n=1 field error; <=1% relative L2 error of n=1 magnetic and kinetic energy histories. Comparisons at matching physical times, no phase shifting.
acceptance.scope: Pilot temporal convergence only. No mesh or toroidal-resolution acceptance and no production dataset.

additional_refinement.reason: First two refinement pairs reduce mode-energy discrepancy from ~79% to ~26%, consistent with convergence but far above 1%; two more halvings probe the predeclared threshold.
additional_refinement.resources: Two independent 2-rank CPU jobs, each capped at 16 minutes and 900 seconds per simulation; no GPU or training.

confirmation_refinement.reason: 375 vs 187.5 still differs by 3.5% in magnetic energy and up to 4.2% relative to field temporal variation. One further level beyond 93.75 supplies a stringent final comparison; output cadence matches dt93.75 exactly.
confirmation_refinement.resources: Two CPU ranks, 8 GB, 22-minute job cap, 1200-second simulation cap.
